What we found at the footbridge, and what to do before winter.

The river

The river , and both times the footbridge held. The second rise came within a hand of the deck boards, which is closer than any year since the bridge was rebuilt.

The path

The path on the north bank is washed out for about twenty metres. Walkers are cutting across the meadow, which is doing more harm than the river did.

Autumn at the footbridge

What we found at the footbridge, and what to do before winter.

The river

The river , and both times the footbridge held. The second rise came within a hand of the deck boards, which is closer than any year since the bridge was rebuilt.

We recommend raising the deck by one course before the spring melt. The cost is modest and the work can be done in two days with the water low.

The path

The path on the north bank is washed out for about twenty metres. Walkers are cutting across the meadow, which is doing more harm than the river did.

Prompt to build this component

When to use it

When to use

  • For a setting that is on or off and takes effect at once: comment mode, hiding comments, showing resolved threads.
  • In a menu row or a panel footer, where the word beside it names what is switched.

When not to use

  • For a choice that waits for a Save: use cmp-checkbox.
  • For picking one of several values: use cmp-segmented-control or cmp-select.
Variants, anatomy, accessibility, interaction and content rules

Variants

Not applicable: one look. To add variants, replace this line with one bullet per variant, each a variant id, a dash and what it is for.

Anatomy

  • Root: <button class="ds-switch" type="button" role="switch" aria-checked="false" aria-label="<what it switches>">, a small ink-edged track.
  • Knob: <span class="ds-switch__knob"></span>, a square of paper that slides from the start to the end of the track.
  • The word that names the setting sits beside the switch in the row that holds it; the switch's aria-label repeats it.

Accessibility

  • A native button with the switch role and aria-checked; Enter and Space flip it, and screen readers hear "on" or "off".
  • The on state is shown by the knob's place and the track's fill, never by colour alone.
  • Disabled uses the disabled attribute.

Interaction

  • Flipping slides the knob by its own width over --ds-motion-settle on --ds-motion-ease, and the track's fill changes over --ds-motion-quick (int-04); the switch never changes size (int-03).
  • Hover darkens the track over --ds-motion-quick; focus shows the shared ring (int-01, int-02).
  • Under reduced motion the knob moves at once (int-06).

Content rules

  • The aria-label names the setting as the row reads it: "Start commenting", "Hide comments".

Do and don't

  • Do keep a word beside every switch.
  • Don't use a switch for something that needs a confirmation.
